metrics.definition: Fraction of tasks whose final report satisfies must_include, must_exclude, and required_answer_facets.
Invalid tool calls divided by total tool calls, where invalid means schema, precondition, wrong-order, or unavailable-tool violation.
Fraction of injected-fault tasks where the agent notices the symptom and recovers the oracle-required papers or report sections.
Whether the agent's primary attribution label matches oracle.ground_truth_attribution_labels.
Relative reduction in tool calls or estimated token/tool cost against a baseline trace for the same task.
